According to the government's Moneysmart website, private funerals typically cost somewhere in the region of $4,000 for a basic cremation up to $15,000 for a more elaborate burial. If you can't afford to pay a funeral and the deceased person doesn't have enough money in their estate, the government will pay for a very basic funeral, which you'll still be able to attend.
